features.description: Every feature needs a name the reports can be keyed by (progress/impl_<name>.md), a one-line title, and acceptance criteria specific enough that a reviewer can check them off without asking you anything.
acceptance: Criteria are observable from outside the code
Each criterion names the behaviour, not the implementation
A test exists that fails if the criterion is violated
